name: tellz
description: Tellz reads what your competitors publish in public each night and brings your daily brief into ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Tellz reads what your competitors publish in public each night. It gives you one short brief each day, at the time you choose. It works for any business whose competitors post in public. It reads their Instagram posts, reels and stories, their Facebook and Instagram ads, and their LinkedIn posts. It also reads news that names them, and web pages you ask it to watch, with the offers on them. It lists public posts that tag or name your own business. Each brief starts with the 3 things that changed most, then the posts, ads, offers and news behind them. Every item links to the original. With Tellz connected, ask for today's brief or any past day's, with its picture and a link to the full report. Search everything Tellz collected for a competitor, an offer or a word, or ask what one competitor did. Follow, pause or stop following a competitor, watch a news source or a page, or move the time your brief arrives. Tellz reads each change back and waits for your yes. A new competitor also needs one tap in Tellz. You can undo a change for 7 days. You need a Tellz account. You sign in with your work email and a code we send to it. When you connect, you choose whether the assistant may only read or may also make the changes you ask for. Tellz reads public sources only: never private accounts, logins, direct messages or comments. It never posts or sends messages for you, and it cannot change your plan or billing or delete your account. Every number in a brief comes from the source it cites.
capabilities: Open the brief for any past date
Search everything collected for a competitor, an offer or a word
Say what one competitor did or is offering
Say what Tellz reads and what it does not
Follow, pause or stop following a competitor, after your yes
Watch a news source or a web page, after your yes
Move the time your brief arrives, after your yes
defaultPrompt: What did my competitors do today?
What is each competitor offering this month?

positive.description: Today's brief: the picture, the text as Tellz wrote it, and the report link.
positive.prompt: What did my competitors do today?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the brief picture, then the brief text as Tellz wrote it (the verdict and the things that changed, each naming its competitor), then the report link. Every number matches the brief; none is added. If today's brief is not out yet, it says which day it shows and when today's arrives.

positive.description: The brief for a past date.
positive.prompt: Show me the Tellz report for yesterday.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns yesterday's brief with its picture and verdict, or says there is no report for that date and names the latest one.

positive.description: Search past briefs for a word.
positive.prompt: Did any competitor post about brunch in the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the matching items (up to 20), each with the competitor, the day and a link to the original post, or says none were found. It does not search the web.

positive.description: A coverage question answered from Tellz's own coverage list.
positive.prompt: Can Tellz track my competitors' TikTok accounts?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers from the coverage list in profile: says plainly whether TikTok can be followed for this account and what Tellz reads instead. It claims nothing the coverage list does not show.

positive.description: A change made only after the reader's yes.
positive.prompt: Send my daily brief at 08:30 instead.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls set_report_time with 08:30; ChatGPT shows its approval card; after the reviewer approves, the brief time changes from tomorrow's brief, and undo_change can reverse it within 7 days. Without approval nothing changes.

negative.description: Account deletion is not available through the connector. Tellz calls no change tool and points the reader to Settings in Tellz.
negative.prompt: Delete my Tellz account and all my data.

negative.description: Plans and billing are not available through the connector. No tool is called and no plan or price is offered.
Tellz reads public sources only. It declines to read private messages or anything behind a login.
negative.prompt: Read the private messages on my competitor's Instagram account.

review.commerce_description: Tellz does not sell anything or take payments in ChatGPT. It works with an existing Tellz account.

publication.release_notes: First release. Read today's competitor brief or any past day's, search everything collected, ask what a competitor did, and make the changes the reader asks for (follow, pause or stop a competitor, watch a publication or page, move the brief time), each with its own tool and undo within 7 days.
